tooltip.essentialcraft5.void_helmet.en: Converts the life energy of fallen foes into food
tooltip.essentialcraft5.void_helmet.zh: 将倒下敌人的生命能量转化为你的饱食度

tooltip.essentialcraft5.void_armor.shiel.en: While charged, blocks its share of melee and projectile damage (about %s MRU per point)
tooltip.essentialcraft5.void_armor.shiel.zh: 有电时挡下近战和弹射物伤害里它那一份（每点约 %s MRU）

tooltip.essentialcraft5.void_armor.shiel.en: Also blocks its share of fire, explosion and lightning damage (about %s MRU per point); burning and freezing that ignore armor still get through
tooltip.essentialcraft5.void_armor.shiel.zh: 火、爆炸、闪电伤害也挡它那一份（每点约 %s MRU）；着火后一直掉的血、在细雪里的冻伤无视护甲，照旧不挡

tooltip.essentialcraft5.void_armor.fulls.en: - After dodging an enemy's hit, your next melee hit within %2$s seconds deals %1$s more damage (Void Riposte)
tooltip.essentialcraft5.void_armor.fulls.zh: - 躲开敌人的一下以后，%2$s 秒内你下一次近战打中多 %1$s 伤害（虚空回击）

tooltip.essentialcraft5.void_armor.fulls.en: - Hoanna's Sun Array, Earthquake and Poison Fumes affect you %s less
tooltip.essentialcraft5.void_armor.fulls.zh: - 海纳尔的日阵、地震、毒雾对你的影响减少 %s

tooltip.essentialcraft5.attunement.void_.en: Chestplate dodges enemy attacks 25%% of the time, and an enemy you dodge gets Slowness II for 1 second (Mire); each piece holds twice the MRU
tooltip.essentialcraft5.attunement.void_.zh: 胸甲闪避敌人攻击的几率 25%%，被你躲开的敌人缓慢 II 1 秒（滞涩）；每件能存的 MRU 翻倍

tooltip.essentialcraft5.attunement.void_.en: Boots negate all fall damage; with all four at stage 2, your Hoanna radiation vulnerability is halved again, Void Riposte deals 75%% more and the Sun Array, Earthquake and Poison Fumes affect you 75%% less
tooltip.essentialcraft5.attunement.void_.zh: 靴子免掉全部摔落伤害；四件都到 2 阶时，海纳尔辐射的易伤再减一半，虚空回击多 75%% 伤害，日阵、地震、毒雾的影响减少 75%%

tooltip.essentialcraft5.attunement.void_.en: The shield costs 7/8 as much per point (350 MRU by default); it also blocks fire, explosion and lightning damage, at twice the cost per point (burning and freezing that ignore armor still get through)
tooltip.essentialcraft5.attunement.void_.zh: 护盾每挡 1 点的电费降到 7/8（默认 350 MRU）；也挡火、爆炸、闪电伤害，这种每点电费翻倍（着火后一直掉的血、在细雪里的冻伤无视护甲，照旧不挡）

tooltip.essentialcraft5.attunement.void_.en: Chestplate dodges enemy attacks 30%% of the time; with all four at stage 4, nothing can hurt you for half a second after you dodge an enemy (Phase Shift), and the Sun Array, Earthquake and Poison Fumes no longer affect you
tooltip.essentialcraft5.attunement.void_.zh: 胸甲闪避敌人攻击的几率 30%%；四件都到 4 阶时，躲开敌人以后半秒内什么都伤不到你（相位），日阵、地震、毒雾也不再影响你
